mapper.insert: insert into application_table(memberId, boardId, applicantName, univName, department, univEmail, info) values(#{memberId}, #{boardId}, #{applicantName}, #{univName}, #{department}, #{univEmail}, #{info})
mapper.select: select id, memberId, boardId from application_table where boardId=#{boardId}
SELECT * FROM application_table WHERE boardId = #{boardId} AND memberId = #{memberId}
select count(*) from application_table where boardId=#{boardId} and memberId=#{memberId}
select b.boardTitle, a.applicantName, a.univName, a.department, a.univEmail, a.info from application_table a join board_table b on b.id = a.boardId where b.boardWriter = #{boardWriter}
